scope: Authored conditional source theory; five fixed evidence roles; no world-truth or general Arabic claim.
model: Two shared affine sigmoid operators AND and OR; six trained parameters. Exact source memory is retained independently.
training: All eight primitive Boolean input/operator combinations. No episode labels or test rows enter fitting.
evaluation: identity plus ten single-source activation/withdrawal contexts
all ordered pairs of these contexts
held-out multiple witnesses and source identities
NTP/NTL receipt replay and request/source/model tampering
baselines: answer-only optimal current-answer grouping lower bound on update loss
selection: Fixed final epoch; no fitting, normalization, threshold or model selection using evaluation.
runtime_integration: Existing cognitive.lesson through NTP; original SemanticKernel owns scoped answers and proof replay.
